h1:
Where to Stay in Chumphon?
12 Stays We've Reviewed
Prices Compared Across 3 Sites
heroSub: Twelve Chumphon stays across every budget — a private-beach resort with an infinity pool at Sai Ri down to a town hostel from ฿350. Covering the spots travellers actually use: Sai Ri beach, Thung Wua Laen, Pathio and Chumphon town. Starting from around ฿350–4,500/night.
introH2: 🏖️ Why does choosing the right base in Chumphon matter so much?
introHtml: Chumphon is the gateway to the south that many people only drive through or overnight in before catching the ferry to Koh Tao and Koh Phangan — but it has quiet beaches and nature that feel genuinely different, so matching your stay to what you want to do matters more than the hotel itself. Sai Ri beach is a quiet stretch beside the Mu Ko Chumphon National Park, ideal if you want to sleep by the sea · Thung Wua Laen–Pathio is a long white-sand beach with resorts and dive centres · Pak Nam Chumphon is the seafront near the pier · and Chumphon town is the staging point before the train or the island ferries, with food and a night market. Many travellers book without checking whether their stay is on the beach or in town, then spend tens of minutes driving every time they want to reach the centre or the sea. This guide brings together 12 Chumphon stays we've reviewed across every tier — every pick comes from reading real guest reviews, with prices compared across 3 sites and direct booking links throughout.
mrtHtml: Chumphon has no metro — the main ways to get around are by train, road and boat. The town has the railway station travellers use to overnight before catching the ferry to Koh Tao and Koh Phangan from the Pak Nam pier. Most beaches and resorts are out of town, so driving or renting a car is easiest. The main destinations in this guide: Sai Ri beach — The Nest Private Beach Resort, Had Sai Resort (a quiet beach beside the Mu Ko Chumphon National Park) · Thung Wua Laen–Pathio — Chumphon Cabana, Armonia Village (white sand, dive centre) · Pak Nam Chumphon — The Nouveau Chumphon Beach Resort (seafront, golf course) · Town — A-Te, Chumphon Palace, Nana Buri, Chumphon Gardens, Morakot, Loft Mania, Salsa Hostel, the staging point before the train or island ferries.

entries.name: The Nest Private Beach Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Sai Ri beach · beside Mu Ko Chumphon park · private beach
tags: 🏖️ Private beach in a quiet cove
🤿 Island & dive trips in the park
entries.addr: 100 Moo 7, Hat Sai Ri, Mueang Chumphon
entries.storyHtml: The Nest is a boutique resort on Sai Ri beach that delivers a genuine private beach in a small cove beside the Mu Ko Chumphon National Park, built new in 2021 with just 21 rooms and villas. Real reviews praise being able to walk straight from your room down to the sand with almost no outsiders around; the infinity pool whose edge blends into the sea line is the spot guests mention most, and the attentive staff help arrange diving and island trips. It suits couples and anyone wanting to use the resort as a base for the sea rather than going into town every day.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The Beachfront Villa with a terrace stepping straight onto the sand is worth more than a Deluxe set further back. Parking is limited, so arrive early in the day, and bring snacks and water as shops outside the resort are far.
pros: Private beach in a quiet cove beside Mu Ko Chumphon park, walk straight from your room
Beautiful sea-view infinity pool, the resort's highlight
Rooms and villas built new in 2021 — spacious, clean, well decorated
Friendly staff who help arrange diving and island trips in the park
cons: Parking is limited and tricky to access in places
About 25 minutes from town · limited food options outside main meals

entries.name: Chumphon Cabana Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Thung Wua Laen beach · Pathio · right on the sand
tags: 🏖️ Right on Thung Wua Laen beach
entries.addr: 69 Moo 8, Thung Wua Laen Beach, Saphli, Pathio
entries.storyHtml: Chumphon Cabana is a resort that sits right on Thung Wua Laen beach — a few steps to the sea — with an in-house dive centre and a local self-sufficiency-farm story, scoring 8.6. Real reviews praise the clean rooms, comfy beds and cold air-con, plus a quiet feel that suits families and anyone after a proper rest. Its strengths are the beachfront location and the easygoing warmth that's hard to find. Worth knowing: there's no swimming pool here (you swim off the beach), and it's out of town, so plan ahead if you don't have a car.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For full sea views go for the Sea View Villa with Bathtub. The seafood is fresh but pricey, so plan to eat at the Thung Wua Laen restaurants too. Having your own car makes getting around much easier.
pros: Right on Thung Wua Laen beach, a few steps to the sea
In-house dive centre, ideal if you want to get out on the water
Clean rooms, comfortable beds, cold air-con
Friendly staff and a quiet feel that suits families
cons: No swimming pool — you swim off the beach
Seafood is fairly pricey · out of town, a car helps

entries.name: The Nouveau Chumphon Beach Resort and Golf
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Pak Nam Chumphon · seafront · 3 min from Pak Nam beach
entries.addr: 112/3 Moo 1, Chumphon-Pak Nam Road, Wang Phai, Mueang Chumphon
entries.storyHtml: The Nouveau is a seafront resort that wins on space, big rooms and quiet, at an attainable 4-star price, scoring 8.3 from 71 reviews. A former Novotel, it stands out for its large pool with a kids' pool, spacious rooms with soft beds and big bathtubs, plus a 9-hole golf course on site. Reviews call it good value with friendly staff. Worth knowing: some rooms are dated and awaiting refurbishment, and parts of the beach in front can collect washed-up debris. It suits anyone driving through or wanting an easygoing seafront rest.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a sea view, choose the Superior Sea View. Suite prices climb in peak season, so a Superior is better value. It's out of town, so a car helps, and check the room condition at check-in as older and newer rooms differ.
pros: Very spacious grounds, seafront and quietly private
Spacious rooms, soft beds, big bathtubs
Large, clean pool with a separate kids' pool
9-hole golf course · friendly staff and good value
cons: Some rooms are dated, furniture awaiting refurbishment
Parts of the beach can collect washed-up debris · out of town, a car needed

entries.name: A-Te Chumphon Hotel
entries.revCount: 184 reviews · in town with a pool
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Central Chumphon · Tha Taphao · 10-min walk to the station
tags: 🚆 Walk to the station and night market
entries.addr: 36 Soi Tha Taphao, Tha Taphao Rd, Tha Taphao, Mueang Chumphon
entries.storyHtml: A-Te is a town hotel in Chumphon with a swimming pool, a good breakfast and spacious, clean rooms at a price that still works, scoring 8.7 from 184 reviews — the most of any town hotel here. Many real reviews call the buffet breakfast the best they've had, with big rooms, large windows and strong water pressure, plus a rare pool right in the centre. It's a tidy overnight base before the island ferry. Worth knowing: some rooms can smell musty and there's no dinner restaurant on site, so you'll walk out in the evening.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: To step into the pool from your room, pick the Deluxe Twin Pool Terrace or a Pool Access Room. If a room smells musty, run the air-con or ask to switch. For dinner, the night market is a short walk away.
pros: Excellent buffet breakfast — many call it the best they've had
Spacious, clean rooms, large windows, strong water pressure
A pool in the town centre, friendly service
Walk to the station and night market, free parking
cons: Some rooms can smell musty — air the room or ask to switch
No dinner restaurant on site, you walk out in the evening

entries.name: Chumphon Palace Hotel
entries.revCount: 55 reviews · 300 m from the railway station
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Town centre · 300 m walk from the station
entries.addr: 328/15 Pracha Uthit Rd, Tha Taphao, Mueang Chumphon
entries.storyHtml: Chumphon Palace is the highest-scoring of the town hotels here — 8.9 from just ฿450. Its strength is a location only 300 metres' walk from the railway station, making it a tidy one-night base before the ferry to Koh Tao and Koh Phangan. Real reviews praise the clean rooms, comfy beds, easygoing staff who help with boat and car tickets, and free parking. Worth knowing: the building is older with plain decor, and the air-con in some rooms is an older model that doesn't cool enough on the hottest days.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a room in better condition, pick the refurbished Superior Room. On very hot days, ask for a room with newer air-con. Have the staff book your island ferry ticket — it's easier than arranging it yourself.
pros: Central, only 300 metres' walk from the railway station
Clean rooms, comfortable beds, budget price from ฿450
Easygoing staff who help with boat and car tickets
Free parking, ideal for an overnight before the ferry
cons: Older building with plain decor, no special design
Air-con in some rooms is an older model · no pool

entries.name: Nana Buri Hotel
entries.revCount: 198 reviews · the most reviewed in this guide
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Central Chumphon · Tha Taphao · near the night market
tags: 🚆 Walk to the station and night market
entries.addr: 335/9 Pracha Uthit Rd, Tha Taphao, Mueang Chumphon
entries.storyHtml: Nana Buri is the most reviewed stay in this guide — 198 reviews from ฿900, which shows it's a stay travellers genuinely rely on. Real reviews praise the spacious, clean, good-value rooms, a location within walking distance of the station and night market, easygoing staff who help with boat and bus tickets, plus breakfast and free parking. Worth knowing: the walls are fairly thin so you'll hear neighbours, the beds are on the firm side, and there's no pool — it's a pure town hotel.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For more space, pick a Superior or Suite. As the walls are thin, ask for a higher floor or an inner room for quiet. The beds are firm, so if you need a soft mattress, compare elsewhere.
pros: The most reviewed in this guide, 198 — a stay travellers genuinely use
Central, walk to the station and night market
Spacious, clean rooms, good value
Staff help well with boat and bus tickets · breakfast + free parking
cons: Fairly thin walls, you'll hear neighbours · beds are firm
No pool — it's a pure town hotel

entries.name: Chumphon Gardens Hotel
entries.revCount: 114 reviews · near the station and fresh market
entries.mrtTag: 📍 In town · near the fresh market and station
entries.addr: 66/1 Tha Taphao Rd, Tha Taphao, Mueang Chumphon
entries.storyHtml: Chumphon Gardens is a town hotel that stands out for spacious rooms, a budget price, easy parking and a much-praised breakfast, scoring 8.6 from 114 reviews. Real reviews praise the varied, tasty buffet breakfast, spacious rooms with soft beds, and roomy parking, in a location near the market and station. It's a tidy stopover mid-journey or before the island ferry. Worth knowing: the building is older, some mattresses are starting to sag, and there's no pool.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Book a Superior with Breakfast — it's better value given how praised the breakfast is. Some mattresses are starting to sag, so it's fine to compare rooms at check-in. Driving in, the parking is roomy and easy.
pros: Varied, tasty buffet breakfast that gets a lot of praise
Spacious rooms, soft beds, comfortable sleep
Roomy parking, easy to use
In town, near the market and railway station
cons: Building and decor are aged · some mattresses starting to sag
No pool or fitness room

entries.name: Armonia Village Resort and Spa
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Near Thung Wua Laen beach · Saphli, Pathio · ~1 km from the beach
entries.storyHtml: Armonia Village is a quiet garden-villa resort near Thung Wua Laen beach where pets stay at no extra charge, scoring 8.1. Real reviews praise the standalone villas that feel private and calm, easygoing helpful staff, and a varied, fresh-cooked breakfast that draws a lot of praise. Its strengths are the privacy and being pet-friendly. Worth knowing: it's not on the beach (about 1 km away), the Wi-Fi is weak in some villas set far from the main building, and the quiet, out-of-town setting suits people with a car who want a slow stay.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Travelling as a group or with pets, the 2 Bedrooms Villa is better value. Ask for a villa near the main building for stronger Wi-Fi and a shorter walk to the pool and restaurant. There's nothing to walk to at night, so bring snacks.
pros: Standalone garden villas, private and calm
Pets stay at no extra charge
Varied, fresh-cooked breakfast that's much praised
Easygoing, helpful staff
cons: Not on the beach, about 1 km away · weak Wi-Fi in some far villas
Quiet, out of town, nothing to walk to at night

entries.name: Morakot Hotel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Central Chumphon · Tha Taphao · ~12-min walk to the station
tags: 🚆 Walk to the station and night market
entries.addr: 118 Soi Thawi Sinkha, Thawi Sinkha Rd, Tha Taphao, Mueang Chumphon
entries.storyHtml: Morakot is a central town hotel that genuinely stands out for rooms larger than the price suggests and bathtubs that are rare at this budget, scoring 8.4 from ฿650. Real reviews praise the very spacious rooms, many with bathtubs, plus a pool, buffet breakfast and free parking, with a location within walking distance of the station and night market. Worth knowing: the building is ageing and room quality differs clearly between the old and new wings, and the walls are fairly thin — it suits people focused on value and location.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a new-wing room for clearly better condition and furniture than the old wing. For a spacious room with a bathtub, pick a Superior. As walls are thin, ask for a room away from the corridor for quiet.
pros: Very spacious rooms, many with bathtubs, good value
Central, walk to the station and night market
A pool, buffet breakfast and free parking
Cold air-con, Wi-Fi works in most rooms
cons: Old-wing rooms are clearly more worn than the new wing
Fairly thin walls, you'll hear neighbours

entries.name: Loft Mania Boutique Hotel
entries.revCount: 52 reviews · loft style · pool with jacuzzi
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Chumphon town · Tha Taphao · 10-min walk to the station
tags: 🚢 Helps arrange cars and island ferry tickets
entries.addr: 89/9 Phisit Phayaban Rd, Tha Taphao, Mueang Chumphon
entries.storyHtml: Loft Mania is a loft-style boutique hotel in central Chumphon with a pool and jacuzzi and spacious rooms at an affordable price, scoring 8.3. It stands out for travellers using Chumphon as a stopover before the island ferry — real reviews praise the location within a 10-minute walk of the station with food easy to find, the infinity-style pool with jacuzzi, spacious clean rooms many with a kitchenette, and staff who help arrange cars and ferry tickets. Worth knowing: breakfast isn't the strong point, some rooms have noise, and the shower pressure is light for some.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For more space and a kitchenette, pick a Loft Suite or Family Suite. The breakfast choice is limited, so it's easy to eat out nearby in town. Some rooms have air-con or system noise — you can ask to switch if it bothers you.
pros: Central, within a 10-minute walk of the station, food easy to find
Infinity-style pool with a jacuzzi
Spacious, clean rooms, many with a kitchenette and fridge
Friendly staff who help arrange cars and island ferry tickets
cons: Limited breakfast choice, flavours not quite there
Some rooms have air-con or system noise · light shower pressure

entries.name: Salsa Hostel
entries.revCount: 34 reviews · highest score in this guide · owner-run
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Chumphon town · Tha Taphao · ~580 m to the station
tags: 🎒 The highest score in this guide, 9.2
🚢 Books Koh Tao ferry tickets with no fee
🧹 Very clean rooms and common areas
entries.addr: 25/42 Krom Luang Chumphon Rd, Tha Taphao, Mueang Chumphon
entries.storyHtml: Salsa Hostel is the highest-scoring stay in this guide — 9.2 from just ฿350 a bed, ideal for backpackers overnighting before the island ferry. Real reviews agree on the owner and staff who help a great deal and speak fluent English, booking ferry tickets to Koh Tao and Koh Phangan with no added fee, and the cleanliness of both rooms and common areas. It's central, within walking distance of the station and night market. Worth knowing: it's a small hostel, the shared dorms have some noise, and there's no pool or sea view.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For more privacy, pick the Standard Room double or the quieter 4-bed dorm. Have the owner book your Koh Tao ferry at check-in — it's easy and fee-free. Bring earplugs if you're in a shared dorm.
pros: Owner and staff help a great deal and speak fluent English
Books ferry tickets to Koh Tao/Koh Phangan with no added fee
Very clean rooms and common areas
Central, walk to the station and night market
cons: Small hostel, limited space and rooms
Shared dorms have some noise · no pool or sea view

entries.name: Had Sai Resort Chumphon
entries.revCount: 38 reviews · on Sai Ri beach · pet-friendly
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Sai Ri beach · near Khao Chao Mueang viewpoint · on the beach
tags: 🏖️ On Sai Ri beach, walk to the sea
entries.addr: 99/6-7 Moo 7, Hat Sai Ri, Mueang Chumphon
entries.storyHtml: Had Sai Resort is a simple resort that sells mainly on its Sai Ri beach location and budget price, suited to anyone wanting to sleep by the sea on a modest budget who isn't fussed about how new the rooms are. Real reviews note you really can walk to the sea, with an in-house restaurant, bikes for hire, pet-friendly policy and free parking. Honestly though, the score sits at a borderline 6.4, the rooms are basic, some don't have a full sea view, and peak-season value is worth checking carefully before booking — we include it as the cheapest beachfront option on Sai Ri.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a sea view, pick the Guest Room Sea View and avoid rooms without one. Compare peak-season prices across the 3 sites before booking, as value varies a lot. The area is quiet with few dinner options at night, so bring some food.
pros: On Sai Ri beach, you really can walk to the sea
Budget price, suited to a tight budget that still wants the beach
In-house restaurant and bikes for hire
Pet-friendly, free parking
cons: Rooms and amenities are fairly basic · some lack a full sea view
Borderline 6.4 review score · quiet area, few dinner options at night

adviceTitle: How to choose the right Chumphon stay for you

advice.head: Tight budget, best value
advice.bodyHtml: → Salsa Hostel from ฿350/bed, 9.2 in town · or Chumphon Palace ฿450, a town hotel 300 m from the station

advice.head: Sleep by the sea, hear the waves
advice.bodyHtml: → The Nest Private Beach Resort ฿4,500, private beach and infinity pool at Sai Ri · or Chumphon Cabana ฿1,900, on Thung Wua Laen beach with a dive centre

advice.head: Stay in town but want a pool
advice.bodyHtml: → A-Te Chumphon Hotel ฿1,300 with a pool and a praised breakfast · or Morakot Hotel ฿650 with spacious rooms, bathtubs and a pool

advice.head: Just overnighting before the island ferry
advice.bodyHtml: → Salsa Hostel ฿350, books Koh Tao ferry tickets fee-free · or Chumphon Palace ฿450 / Nana Buri ฿900 near the station

advice.head: Bringing a pet
advice.bodyHtml: → Armonia Village Resort and Spa ฿1,800, garden villas where pets stay free · or Had Sai Resort ฿1,200 on Sai Ri beach, pet-friendly

advice.head: Want a spacious seafront resort
advice.bodyHtml: → The Nouveau Chumphon Beach Resort & Golf ฿2,590, seafront at Pak Nam with a 9-hole golf course and a large pool

advice.head: Want a boutique-design stay in town
advice.bodyHtml: → Loft Mania Boutique Hotel ฿1,100, loft style with a pool and jacuzzi · or Chumphon Gardens ฿700, spacious rooms with a much-praised breakfast

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices are approximate starting rates for standard rooms and may change by date and season. Always check live prices and compare the 3 sites before booking · Over long weekends and high season, when more people head south, prices rise and rooms fill fast — book ahead · Chumphon has no metro; you travel by train, road and boat, and most beachfront resorts are out of town, so a car helps · Article by ThailandAddict.com
faqTitle: FAQ — Common traveller questions about Chumphon hotels

faq.q: ❓ Where should travellers stay in Chumphon?
faq.a: It depends on what you want to do · Sai Ri beach suits those wanting to sleep by a quiet sea beside the Mu Ko Chumphon park (The Nest, Had Sai Resort) · Thung Wua Laen–Pathio suits those after white sand and diving (Chumphon Cabana, Armonia Village) · Pak Nam Chumphon suits those wanting a spacious seafront resort (The Nouveau) · Town suits an overnight before the island ferry, with food and a night market (A-Te, Chumphon Palace, Nana Buri, Chumphon Gardens, Morakot, Loft Mania, Salsa Hostel)

faq.q: ❓ How much do Chumphon hotels cost?
faq.a: Prices vary widely: budget hostels and town hotels start around ฿350–900/night · town hotels with a pool and boutiques are around ฿1,100–1,300 · 4-star beach resorts around ฿1,900–2,590 · and a private-beach resort like The Nest starts around ฿4,500 · Over long weekends and high season, beach prices can run higher than usual, so book ahead

faq.q: ❓ Is Chumphon good for connecting to the Koh Tao–Koh Phangan ferry?
faq.a: Very much so · Chumphon is a popular ferry connection point to Koh Tao and Koh Phangan from the Pak Nam Chumphon pier, and many travellers take the train down to overnight in town before the boat · Town stays like Salsa Hostel, Chumphon Palace and Nana Buri help book ferry tickets and arrange transfers to the pier, easier than doing it yourself

faq.q: ❓ Do I need a car to explore Chumphon?
faq.a: If you'll stay on the beach, a car or rental is recommended, as the beach resorts at Sai Ri, Thung Wua Laen and Pathio are out of town, several tens of minutes' drive, with few dinner spots at night · But if you stay in town for the ferry or train, you can walk to the station, markets and restaurants easily, and a car isn't necessary

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should I book a Chumphon hotel?
faq.a: On weekdays outside the tourist season, booking 1–2 weeks ahead is enough · But over long weekends, high season and festivals when more people head south or to the islands, beachfront stays and the better town rooms fill quickly, so book 3–4 weeks ahead or more, especially small resorts with few rooms like The Nest

faq.q: ❓ Which site is cheapest for booking Chumphon hotels?
faq.a: Prices on each site (Agoda, Booking.com, Trip.com) differ by promotion at any given time, so compare all 3 before booking every time — each review page in this guide has price-comparison links, which can save hundreds of baht a night
